balls.text: Bhuvneshwar angles this full into Johnson, he has yet another swing and miss, and the ball hits middle
slow and wide outside off from round the stumps, Johnson swings and misses as it stays low
swung through midwicket
mishits a slog towards long on, they go for the second, easy run out had the throw hit
full into leg stump, Bailey clears front leg, gets under it and lifts it straight to long on
Bhuvneshwar starts with a very high full toss, Bailey swings hard, gets a top edge that flies over short third man, not called a no-ball for height, Bhuvneshwar lucky there
short of a length, Bailey makes some room and chops it to point
pitched up in to the legs, Johnson still cannot connect and it rolls away after hitting his pad
missed out there, it was a high and wide full toss, Johnson swung and missed, it is called a wide, Steyn cannot believe it
fast and full outside off, Johnson cannot get bat on it
goes full and very wide, he reaches out and can only stab it to extra cover
full around off, lifted softly in the air through midwicket
tries to dab a back of a length ball outside off, is beaten
Glenn Maxwell can do everything but he cannot get to hundred, falls in the 90s again, swats this full delivery flat and straight to long off
fast full toss at 108.5 kph, Maxwell plants front foot out and pummels it into the sight screen
darted in full and squeezed wide of the sweeper
tossed up googly now, Bailey has no idea about it, underedges it onto pad as it rushes in towards leg stump
too full to get under this time and driven to extra cover
flighted full and slow outside off, Maxwell waits and carts it into the upper tier beyond long on
tosses it up too wide outside off
full and moving away a tad outside off, he opens the face, runs it to backward point
very full on off stump, can't get under it and drives to extra cover
goes outside off and tries to whip a full one to leg, does not get hold of it, takes the run
this is an outswinging yorker outside off, Maxwell jabs bat down on it, third man is square and has little chance with this
moves across to off, Steyn bowls it full and it goes just past the leg stump, not called a wide
makes room and has a heave, misses a length ball that goes just past off stump
full and angled down the leg side, fortunately for him it goes to deep backward square
115 kph slower length ball outside off, Maxwell flat-bats it to the bowler who throws it to the striker's end even as Maxwell scrambles back
sharp yorker on the stumps, can only dig it out
Warner holds on this time, Miller swats a length ball to Warner's right at long off, he comes forward and across and takes it quite safely
slow and full on off, turned along the ground through midwicket
flashes at this one angled across and chops it fine, third man runs across to stop it
tries a full and wide one, Maxwell reaches for it and coolly lifts it into the straight boundary
he was already shuffling across, Sammy gives him a high full toss, and Maxwell whips it right into the deep backward square leg rope
drills a full one to extra cover, who cannot stop it cleanly and parries it away
Sammy gets it very full, and Miller can only force it to deep square leg
they've got him finally, Maxwell's slogged a length ball right into the hands of deep midwicket, but wait, even as Maxwell walks back, replays show Sammy has bowled a big no-ball
oops, he wanted to scoop this over short fine, but it pops up and falls some way down the pitch
length ball on the pad, turned in front of square
incredible hitting this, reverse sweep now, Sharma bowls it full and quick into the legs, but Maxwell is so quick to set himself up to force it high over point
Maxwell abandons the slog sweep for a moment, he skips out to a flighted ball, and lifts it over midwicket, right in the gap, long on has no chance
appeal for lbw as this legbreak spins in, but was headed down the leg side, also hit him outside leg
pushed to extra cover
slog sweep after slog sweep, this is a huge mishit, but will fall in vacant space in front of square leg, Maxwell smiles
Warner in business again at long off, Maxwell has made room outside leg and gone off side now, Warner sets himself up at the rope, but this goes just over him, fifty up, in 21 balls
beaten as he comes forward to a quick one slanted across him
Miller time now, eases smoothly down the track, gets to the pitch and lifts it into the sightscreen
tossed up high and full outside off, driven through extra cover
try whatever you want, the man has one method, slog sweep, and it gets him a third successive six over midwicket as Mishra bowls it flatter and quicker on leg stump now
Mishra flights it high once again, he got Sehwag this way, it is full on leg stump, Maxwell cracks another slog-sweep, it has enough to clear deep midwicket again
tosses up the wrong 'un too full and Maxwell carts it way over the deep midwicket boundary with a fearsome connection on the slog sweep
low full toss squeezed with an open face to deep point
full outside off, hit to extra cover
they've gone for so many in that region tonight, full down the pad with fine leg up, Maxwell swings it hard and almost clears the boundary
slower length ball sits up, Maxwell cranks up and smashes a pull over deep midwicket
comes in to the left-hander with the angle, is worked to deep square
fullish and right on off stump, defended
Pujara slogs probably as hard as he can, but just fails to clear deep midwicket, where Rao moves to his right to take a well-judged catch very close to the rope
that'll go in the gap between point and short third man, a wide yorker, Pujara squeezes it out and splits the gap
wide length ball, Pujara waits and swats it over extra cover, sweeper has plenty of running to do
hit down to long on
swings a fuller one straight over the bowler, long off will get to it
first ball he is reverse swept, but straight to backward point
another chance, Sammy in fact pulled out here at long as Pujara lofted this to his left, was possibly blinded by the lights maybe
beaten by the flight and spin as he comes out, the thick edge beats backward point but Irfan dives to his right at short third man to stop it

David Warner, of all men, has dropped a sitter running in from long off, Maxwell slogged again and hit it high, Warner had enough time to jog in and settle under it, but it popped out, he goes down on the ground in disappointment
Maxwell repeats his preferred stroke, and slog-sweeps powerfully over deep square leg
moves across to try to hit it to leg, but misses
that could have been close, Maxwell slogs, but the mishit falls well short of long on
flights it high, full and slow, Pujara thinks he can cut it, but is beaten
slogged through midwicket for two more
Maxwell slogs the legspinner but does not hit it too well, deep midwicket runs across to his right to field
flat and quick into the pad, he swings it flat and on the bounce to deep square leg
charges out, gets too close to the pitch, and hits it back to the bowler
tossed up full outside off at 85 kph, turned to long on
86.8 kph length ball hurries on to him and bounces, and Maxwell almost pops it to short extra
full delivery worked in the air through vacant midwicket
flat on a length, comes on quickly, is pushed down to long on
another one into the pad, rolls fine past the keeper
misses this one as it slips down leg
hit on the pad with a very full one, but umpire Erasmus shakes his head, was that going down?
comes out, takes it on the full and works it to deep midwicket
googly spins in sharply from outside off, Pujara jabs it away to point

Mishra sticks to his method, he tosses it up full again, this time a touch wider, Sehwag slogs it straight once more, but this time it goes straight to Sammy at long on, the combination of Sehwag and spin never disappoints

Mishra tosses it up about as much as you will see a leggie toss it up in T20, Sehwag waits and wallops it straight and high, Steyn thinks he has a chance at long off, he finds himself outside the rope, and gets out of the way to avoid being hit by the ball as it comes down
Pujara charged out and lofted it down the track, Mishra seems to have got his fingers to it, but it races down to long off
tosses it up full, Sehwag drives it calmly along the ground to long off
quick one pushed back to the bowler
they are making good use of fine leg being up, this is tossed up on middle, Pujara lunges on a knee and sweeps it very cleanly over the man
walks out, Sharma slows it down and Pujara opens the face to play it to covers
not giving him any width, this is angled full into the pad, Sehwag misses the sweep and the ball pops up behind square
slants this flat down the leg side, there is an appeal for caught behind, but this is off the pad
first ball Sehwag goes way outside leg but this is flat and he punches to extra cover
tries to run this widish length ball to third man, underedges it, keeper goes to his right to collect and Pujara has to turn back after rushing out for a single
that zipped through, 143.6 kph short of a length outside off, Pujara tries to dab it, is beaten by the pace and bounce
fine leg is up, Steyn sends in a full rocket on the pads, Pujara gives it direction over the fielder with a stylish, wristy flick
Pujara takes Steyn on again, length ball around off, he picks it and slams it over midwicket again
bounces from a length and takes a thick edge to scoot to point
slower ball and Pujara gets going now, he has smacked it over midwicket
Sehwag knows fine leg is up, this is short, and he swivels sharply to send it soaring over the fine leg boundary
not the width to cut, Sehwag tries to rock back and play the stroke, is beaten as it rises from back of a length
tries a bouncer, Sehwag ducks easily
Sehwag looking much more at ease now, goes back to play this length ball out to point
skips out but mishits this one into the pitch, has got enough for it to bounce over the bowler for a quick single
Irfan pitches this up around off, and Sehwag slams it with disdain over mid off
gave him width outside off, and Sehwag opened up to swat it straight to cover
similar length, straightening down the leg side and Sehwag has enough time to pull hard through square leg this time
shortish on Sehwag's pads, and he is on one leg as he swats it flat over deep backward square leg
walks out and Irfan drops it shorter, it climbs outside off, and Pujara adjusts to slash it in the air to third man
they get the run in the end, Irfan swings a length ball into middle and off, Sehwag pushes to extra cover, who has a go at the non-striker's and misses to concede the single
flashes this length ball straight to cover again
connects nicely with the drive now as he walks out and leans into the shot, but the infield is packed in that cover area
walks out now, gets close to the line of this length ball and pushes it to point
and again, just like Sehwag was beaten twice in a row last over, Pujara has another energetic go at the cut but misses the outswinger
now Pujara is beaten on the cut, it wasn't short, wasn't wide and was curling away
widish length ball moving away, Sehwag follows it and opens the face to squeeze it to third man
cramps him with a short of a length ball dug into the body, Sehwag nudges it to midwicket
angled fuller into him and he opens up trying to work it to leg, it straightens sharply, and he adjusts to push it back
back of a length, closer to him, Sehwag punches off his toes to cover, does not time it at all
exactly what happened last ball, short, wide, leaving him, half-hearted swing and miss
short, wide and swinging away, Sehwag has a weak waft, misses
full away swinger first up, Pujara steps forward and opens the face to drive it to third man
that'll be it, full and slow delivery mishit over midwicket, Johnson runs across from long on and takes a tumbling catch
squeezes a length ball to point off the back foot
pitched up ball hit down to long on
turned in front of square leg off the pad, they settle for one in the end
slower one cuts in from wide outside off, he underedges it on the bounce to the keeper
Balaji has his fourth, offcutter angled in, Steyn swings and misses, and Balaji hits middle
whipped with the angle from off to deep midwicket
pushes a length ball to mid off, who does not pick it up on the first attempt and they safely complete the single
reaches for a full and wide one outside off, it goes in front of square on leg
low and wide full toss squeezed to third man's right
that almost took off stump, as Mishra pushed inside the line of this pitched up delivery
this time a catch sticks, Sharma backs away, Johnson angles it in full and Sharma lifts it tamely to mid off
beaten by a pitched up delivery outside off
another drop, Steyn skies a back of a length ball, keeper's catch as it comes down just behind square on leg close to the stumps, but Saha clangs it
in the blockhole on the stumps, he fails to turn it to leg and it rolls onto the crease
very full just outside off, forced through midwicket
slanted across from back of a length, Steyn cannot connect
slower one outside off, Steyn has a go at edges it along the ground to the keeper
hits a length ball in the air and it falls at vacant mid off
full and across him from round the stumps, driven to cover
Sharma's made some room outside leg, Johnson's bouncer has followed him, but he's somehow managed to hook it over deep square leg
around the blockhole, eased to the bowler
thick outside edge goes flying past slip this time
another skier as Steyn swings and edges, falls in between two men, Maxwell stands and watches as third man comes in and tries to go for it, but it is too late by then
snorter from fast bowler to fast bowler, Steyn prods and misses as this back of a length ball bounces and flies past the edge outside off
drives a pitched up ball down the pitch, Johnson gets a hand to it
comes down the track and squirts this in the air to the sweeper
inside edges a tossed up full ball onto the pad and into the off side
angled in, nudged to midwicket for a single
turned to fine leg off the pad
this has gone miles in the air, Rahul steps out, is not to the pitch of one that straightens, but goes through with the shot, Miller at long off settles under it
moves across and tries to go leg side from wide outside off, is hit on the pad
very full delivery squeezed straight to backward point
pushes a good length ball wide of cover
Sammy's tried to fetch this short of a length ball from way outside off and flat-bat it down the ground but he has not got enough elevation on the mishit, mid off times his jump to take a sharp catch
moves across outside off to turn it to midwicket
shortish ball rising rapidly, he tries to pull this from wide outside off but misses
worked through midiwicket for a single
that was plumb had he not inside edged it first, he was pretty deep in the crease looking to work it to leg
shorter and quicker, he goes back and pulls it down to long on
he will get under this one just outside off and lift it cleanly onto the roof of the stadium way past the long on boundary
wanted to attack this but in the end just pushed it back
back of a length, punched to the bowler
cannot get under this one angled in and knocks it to midwicket instead
short and wide but slow at 114 kph, he underedges it towards the keeper
no width this time, he punches a shortish one to long on
width from back of a length, slapped over extra cover for a couple
mistimes a push to mid off, non-striker rushes for the single, Sammy takes a few steps and stops, Rahul makes it back in time
goes back to hit it to the sweeper
nudges a length ball to the leg side and takes off, bowler rushes after it, direct hit would have been tight
opens the face and squeezes a wide one past backward point's dive
pushes back a full one to the bowler
gone on the slog sweep, 100-plus kph from the left-armer, full around leg, Irfan gets down for the slog sweep, misses and is bowled
in the blockhole, squeezed back
overpitched and Rahul slog-sweeps it just over the man at long on
flat and quick in to the pad at 95.8 kph, turned square
worked in the air through vacant square leg off the pads
beats him on the push with some spin and bounce outside off
short and wide from round the stumps, cut to the sweeper
overpitched again, driven to sweeper cover
overpitched delivery driven to long off
105 kph slower one starts outside leg and goes down straight
length on middle and leg, he goes back to work it to deep square
111.7 kph slower one outside off, Rahul moves outside leg and smashes it past extra cover's dive
length ball punched to wide long on
worked off the pad to deep backward square
drives a full one hard but there is sweeper cover
tries to paddle it from outside off, it rolls fine on the off side instead
defended off the front foot
drives one slanted across him to long off
shout for leg before but that pitched outside leg
steps out and pushes to sweeper cover for a single
Sandeep has been accurate all along, he keeps it on a good length, around off, Rao tries to force it square on the leg side, misses and Sandeep hits off with slight away movement
good length ball driven to deep point
another slower ball on off and middle, turned to square leg
bounces from back of a length, is run to point
length ball on middle, knocked down to long on
slower one full outside off to begin the over, eased to extra cover, direct hit would have had him just short
slower one outside off, dabbed to short third man
over midwicket now, attacks a length delivery from outside off and crashes it one bounce over the rope
succeeds this time, another one gets up, not as much as the previous one, Rao is ready and cuts it high over point
that climbed outside off, Rao tried to play at it, but was beaten
chops this from close to the body down to third man
drags a pull wide of mid on
moves forward and drives a pitched up ball to mid off
Balaji is smiling again, this has kicked at Warner from just back of a length, the surprised batsman jabs at it and it pops tamely to point
angled into middle and off, Rahul moves across to work it to midwicket
starts way outside off and moves further away

gone through him, Balaji angles it in again, pitched up, not really the length to be playing back to, but Finch prefers that, this time he is caught in an awkward position as this rushes in and goes through to hit the stumps
angled in to middle from wide of the crease, played back
holds the line from just back of a length outside off, Finch dabs at it and is beaten
chops a length ball to cover
slow and full outside off, guided to third man
gets some width and slaps the length delivery in the air and wide of extra cover
and he gets away with another free hit, a slow back of a length ball down the leg side, it pings Warner on the glove as he tries to adjust his pull
terrific stop from Miller at cover, Warner made some room and slapped this length ball, it was racing away before Miller dived to his left to cut it off... and Johnson has bowled another no ball
it is short from Johnson, Finch goes deep in the crease and pulls hard, but straight to Miller at square leg
right on middle stump, on a good length, played to midwicket, and Johnson has overstepped to give a free hit
147 kph short of a length delivery, Finch takes it high on the thigh pad as he fails to nudge it square
this will help him, down the pads this time and Warner sends it wide of short fine leg
Warner not able to get this line and length away at the moment, pitched up around middle and leg, and he squeezes it to point
fuller on the pad, and worked in front of square
wanted to turn this length ball to leg, but played it straight in the end
flashes at a pitched up ball just outside off, inside edges it to the keeper, who does well to dive to his right to stop it
full at 125.6 kph on middle, eased to extra cover
shot, this was fuller, going across, providing him some room to lean forward and stroke it between extra cover and mid off
stays on the crease and plays out a sharp length ball to point
full around off, Warner is a touch late in getting forward and drives it through cover
digs in a bouncer first up to Warner, who tries to hook, in vain
Johnson strikes early, length ball seaming away outside off, Dhawan stands and wafts, and feathers it behind
short, wide and bouncing outside off, Dhawan has a go and misses
drives on the up, on the bounce to mid off, who throws and misses at the non-striker's and they get one for the overthrow
swinging in but starts outside leg and carries further down
driven wide of extra cover for a single
overpitched on the pad now, and is flicked in the air in front of square
fuller this time, and Finch steps forward and lifts it straight with a smooth followthrough
tries to drive a length ball on the off side but ends up hitting it to the bowler
swinging in late and full to off, driven to mid on
